observations: body L1: with al-Battānī's hourly motions of the Moon, 32′ 56″ in longitude and 32′ 40″ in anomaly (Part II, p. 76), and the radius of the epicycle 5p 15′ (p. 221), the hourly motion at the perigee and the apogee of the epicycle is 32′ 56″ + 32′ 40″ × 5;15/54;45 = 36′ 4″ and 32′ 56″ − 32′ 40″ × 5;15/65;15 = 30′ 18″, the numbers of the line.

body L2, L5-L6, L9, L31, L33: the dashes of 10.0 to 10.2 pt are transcribed as dashes; those of «16–18» in the head, «70–72» (L9) and «7–8» (L33, 5.5 pt) are long dashes, as those of the transliterated names (5.2 to 5.6 pt).
body L9-L10, L13, L20, L23-L24, L32, L34, L37: «Ibn Yūnus», «Caussin», «an–Nayrīzī», «al–Battānī», «Ptolemaei» and «Ptolemaeus» are letter-spaced; «al–Battānī» of L23-L24 is not.

body L17, L23-L28: al-Battānī's table of the parallaxes (Part II, p. 94, after Ptolemy) gives at 90° 53′ 34″ for the first distance and 10′ 17″ more for the second, 63′ 51″; the print has 64′ 51″ in L24 and L26, against the difference 10′ 17″ of L28 and of Ibn Yūnus in L17 (64′ 51″ − 53′ 34″ would be 11′ 17″).
body L20-L34: the lines beside the figure end about 380 pt from the edge of the page, the first of them (L20) 8 pt further; the edition sets them to one measure.

body (figure): the two lines from M end on the left side of the cone at R and R′, where the arcs about M cross it; the words «Terra», «Conus» and «umbrae» are in bold italic, crossed by the lines as printed.

body L35-L38: 35′ 1/3 × 2 3/5 = 91′,867 and 29′ 1/2 × 2 3/5 = 76′,7; their halves are 45′ 56″ and 38′ 21″, whose difference 7′ 35″ is al-Battānī's 7′ 1/2 of L37. The printed semidiameters 45′ 54″ and 38′ 42″ differ by Ibn Yūnus' 7′ 12″, but 38′ 42″ is not the half of 76′,7.
notes_right L3: the dash of «Al-Battānī» is a hyphen.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
